meta.rdkit_qed: rdkit.Chem.QED, weights WEIGHT_MEAN; desirabilities from QED.ads with QED.adsParameters
meta.citation: Bickerton GR, Paolini GV, Besnard J, Muresan S, Hopkins AL. Quantifying the chemical beauty of drugs. Nat Chem. 2012;4(2):90-98. doi:10.1038/nchem.1243

defs.label: QED
defs.long: Quantitative estimate of drug-likeness (RDKit, mean weights): 0 to 1, higher is more drug-like

defs.label: QED (max weights)
defs.long: QED with the paper's maximal weights instead of the mean ones

defs.label: Structural alerts
defs.long: Brenk/QED structural alerts matched (the ALERTS term of QED)

defs.label: Rotatable bonds (strict)
defs.long: Rotatable bonds under RDKit's strict definition, as QED counts them

defs.label: Acceptors (QED)
defs.long: Hydrogen-bond acceptors under QED's own SMARTS set, not the Lipinski N+O count

defs.label: Aromatic rings (QED)
defs.long: Aromatic rings as QED counts them (ring perception after deleting aliphatic rings)

defs.label: QED desirability: weight
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to weight: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)

defs.label: QED desirability: log P
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to log P: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)

defs.label: QED desirability: acceptors
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to acceptors: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)

defs.label: QED desirability: donors
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to donors: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)

defs.label: QED desirability: TPSA
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to TPSA: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)

defs.label: QED desirability: rotatable bonds
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to rotatable bonds: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)

defs.label: QED desirability: aromatic rings
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to aromatic rings: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)

defs.label: QED desirability: structural alerts
defs.long: The desirability function QED applies to structural alerts: 0 (bad) to 1 (ideal)
